entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and offers connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. This open-source context database employs L0, L1, and L2 tiered loading layers to provide observable retrieval trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control, including commits and branches. It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface with sub-100ms retrieval across five tiers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports direct memory operations via a Python SDK and supports MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that combines vector search and structured facts to create an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets, and supports multiple agent providers including Pi and MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no message is lost. It utilizes a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summaries for compacted history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It maintains local custody of SQLite and workspace files while achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store data as plain-text files for multi-agent systems. It supports Hermes and Claude Code, offering local-first search capabilities without incurring cloud costs.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP and dedicated plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a durable, file-based long-term memory system that avoids vector databases and embeddings in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. The five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It features built-in contradiction tracking and owner-scoping to manage memory in multi-user environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by prefetching context based on agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep offers reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes and supports automated indexing for codebases and multimedia.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It renders context locally via MCP without requiring a hosted service.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn enables cross-project memory by using a personal Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to store memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates payments for APIs using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to allow AI agents to pay for services.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It supports dense HNSW ANN, sparse and exact-text recall, and MinHash deduplication through embedded or HTTP daemon execution modes.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local knowledge. It is designed to index skills, scripts, markdown documents, and cron jobs, with an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via semantic and literal code search. It runs locally over localhost and supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It is essential for agents requiring structured brainstorming and design refinement phases.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. It integrates with coding agents via CLI and includes features for automation, plugins, and design systems.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It supports Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients for managing ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using three operational modes. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw, and offers optional voice profiles.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement through an Agentic Evolver. It integrates with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs and provides a dashboard for inspecting session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It includes a master router, connector skills, and features like escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The skills are available via npm, PyPI, and Docker and include ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation using slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction without using yt-dlp. It provides access to transcripts, captions, and timestamps for Hermes Agent and other compatible agents.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model. It provides structured memory via file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task and card management.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides interoperable skills for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts via the Agent Skills specification. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration, including specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.

entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of progress and decisions along with built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language for AI uses a single file and four verbs to define intent as code. It provides static auditing via nika check and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and provides incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a 5-layer approach including hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation for missing dependencies.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.

entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests, producing structured briefs that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and hybrid skill management for both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.solomon2773/nora: A self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane designed to run and operate multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities while offering hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. This deployment supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.

entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes that modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. The community-driven project includes diverse aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk styles.

It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.

entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for managing requests that involve side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports connections to local and cloud AI models and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
